extraction.Name: Elizabeth Stirk nee Cottier
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. recorded 2-1-21 by State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. for $2650.00 (recorded Jan. 5, 1923); Mortgaged to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. for $800.00 (recorded Mar. 1, 1924); Mortgaged to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. for $3236.00 (recorded Jan. 19, 1925); NE 32-37-39 deeded to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. for $1.00 on Mar. 5, 1926
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jul. 1, 1918. Land described as NE 32-37-39. All transactions signed by Elizabeth Stirk and George Stirk, her husband. Three separate mortgages to State Bank of Scenic before final deed conveyance for $1.00 on Mar. 5, 1926. Taken from the records at the County Seat.
